digest: 过去 30 天，共追踪到 22 个热门 AI 开源项目（主力语言：Python, TypeScript, Rust）和 13 篇最新 ArXiv 论文。GitHub 最热方向是「Agent 技能与工具」。

papers.abstract: In this paper, we study how training data creates associations between the tokens at the start of a base model's response and the reasoning behavior that follows. First, we demonstrate that fixing par
papers.summary_zh: 发现训练数据中起始词与推理行为的关联，通过固定起始词提示使基座模型推理性能媲美强化学习微调模型

papers.title: Towards Looped Models Done Right, Part II: Rethinking at Fixed Points
papers.abstract: Every recurrence of a looped language model adds cost in training, decoding, prefill, and reinforcement learning (RL). The closer recurrent states get to fixed points, the less the path to them matter

papers.title: UniSlider: Perceptually Uniform Sliders for Continuous Image Editing

papers.title: IdeaLens: Detecting AI Ideas in Long-form Writing

papers.summary_zh: 提出IdeaLens检测器，通过识别文档思想来源判断其源自人类或AI，突破传统AI检测仅关注文字作者的局限

papers.title: One Figure, Every Canvas: Editable Flowchart Relayout via Agentic Pipeline

papers.summary_zh: 提出智能体流水线实现流程图跨画布可编辑重排，适配任意宽高比且保持连接语义完整

papers.title: Recursive Video In-Context Learning for Agentic Robot
papers.abstract: LLM agents that orchestrate frozen vision-language-action (VLA) policies improve across episodes through text memory, which records what the agent did but not how the task is done. A demonstration vid
papers.summary_zh: 提出递归视频上下文学习方法，将演示视频压缩为关键帧记忆供智能体复用，显著提升机器人任务成功率

papers.title: MemPilot: Orchestrating On-Demand Multimodal Memory Curation for LLM Agents
papers.abstract: Memory has become integral to the LLM agent ecosystem, supporting information retention and reuse across interactions. However, most existing agent memory systems construct memory in a query-agnostic
papers.summary_zh: 提出按需多模态记忆编排框架MemPilot，以查询驱动方式动态构建与筛选记忆，降低预处理开销并保留关键细节

papers.title: Learning to Read the Contextual Tokens in Diffusion Transformers
papers.abstract: Multimodal Diffusion Transformers (MM-DiTs) jointly process visual and textual representations throughout generation. These models repeatedly update the text tokens through multimodal attention, formi
papers.summary_zh: 揭示扩散Transformer中文本令牌经多模态注意力动态更新为上下文令牌的机制并提出学习读取方法

papers.title: Direct Intermediate Initialization for Tilted Diffusion Samplers
papers.abstract: Some diffusion posterior samplers construct Gaussian-tilted intermediate distributions along the reverse process. We observe that these targets can be pulled back to clean-space posteriors with weaker
papers.summary_zh: 提出将高斯倾斜中间分布拉回弱条件干净空间后验的初始化方法，实现扩散后验采样器直接中间初始化

papers.title: BiasFlow: Geometric Monitoring and Backbone Regularization for Spurious Feature Reliance
papers.abstract: Worst-group accuracy (WGA) evaluates a trained predictor but does not characterize how its frozen backbone behaves when a new head is learned. We introduce BiasFlow, a hook-based toolkit for monitorin

papers.title: PlotGround: Grounding Plot Digitization in Real Scientific Figures and Their Source Data
papers.abstract: Scientific figures often encode quantitative results that are not readily available in machine-readable form, making accurate plot digitization important for verifying and reusing published findings.
papers.summary_zh: 提出面向真实科学图表与源数据的PlotGround基准，揭示当前模型数字化精度不足并推动更可靠的图表数值提取

papers.title: TasteVal: Measuring the Experimental Research Taste of AI Systems Against Human Experts
papers.abstract: We introduce TasteVal, a benchmark to evaluate the experimental research taste of frontier models. We define research taste as the ability to pick interesting problems to solve, design experiments, an
papers.summary_zh: 提出评估AI实验研究品味的基准TasteVal，从选题、设计实验和解读结果三方面衡量前沿模型与人类专家的差距

papers.title: Deep Learning for Sleep Heart Rate Estimation from Accelerometers: Toward Population-Scale Cardiac Insight Without Optical Sensors
